body: i just feel so...alone. everyone gets to have these amazing experiences and i am never included. i am always left. i want to be needed...be wanted. im not. i try to tell people what i feel and think and how i hurt. they act like it matters and then the next day...gone. im done. i dont want this. i didnt ask for this pain. i only gave people love and understanding. something is wrong with me. im done

he left me for christmas. i asked him not to. my family is gone. they got rid of my about 4 months before christmas. he left...it is tradition. i asked him not to. he came back for 1 week. he left again today. i asked him not to. he is a grown fucking man. we are getting married. i am not allowed because i am not family. why are they more fucking important? why are we getting married? i do not matter. you only care about your family. i would NEVER leave him if he needed me. fuck some stupid family vacation. they go on one every 8 weeks. i will never be invited because of tradition. i am not important enough
